name: Allmed Medical Products Co.,Ltd
summary: Allmed Medical Products Co.,Ltd supplier in medical dressings and infection control solutions in China and internationally. The company offers traditional wound care products include nonwoven and woven gauze swabs, non-adherent pads, drain sponges, abdominal pads, fluffy sponges/bandages, woven gauze and nonwoven gauze balls, eye pads, cotton filled exodontia sponges, packing strips, ribbon gauze, cotton tipped applicators, elastic net bandages, nose bandages, instrument covers, impregnated gauze dressings, adhesive dressings and tapes, wound bandages, kits, and precut gamgee.
